page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c4g1.2xlarge is a GPU-accelerated cloud instance built on x86_64 architecture using KVM virtualization. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs combined with 60.0 GB of memory, providing a ratio of 7.5 GB RAM per vCPU. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing execution without burst credit limits or core contention.

The hardware configuration incorporates two NVIDIA P100 GPUs with a combined total of 32 GB VRAM. Storage is provisioned via 944 GB of local SSD capacity, integrated directly into the host platform. Network connectivity is supported at a 5 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

The combination of dual graphics processing units and local solid-state storage provides efficient hardware density for parallel execution tasks. The presence of direct local SSD storage offers fast throughput for dynamic temporary files, though data persistence management remains necessary. This profile fits deep learning training, video transcoding, parallel scientific processing, and accelerated matrix computations.
